Name: Museum Always Open - Do It Like Blathers
Author: alextofu
Description:
[center]﻿[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/0Vq5SfW/museum-always-open.png[/img][/url]﻿
﻿[/center]A small content mod that unlocks the museum so it can be open all the time! I keep forgetting to go in time so I made this for my personal use but some other people might find it useful. I am aware that there are other mods that do similar things but I only wanted it to be the museum for my fellow animal crossers.
For a mod that unlocks all the town doors and more configurations please check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19224]Dynamic Locked Doors[/url] by the lovely AirynS.

[b][size=4]Installation:
[/size][/b]Download and unzip into your mods folder.

[size=4][b]Compatibility:
[/b][/size]This mod affects the vanilla game museum, any mods that change it's location will be incompatible. Probably not compatible with SVE and won't be (sorry, hopefully understandable).

[b][size=4]Credits:[/size][/b]
[url=https://www.kdau.com/scrollish/]Stardew Scroll Generator[/url] by kdau.

If there is anything worth noting please feel free to post a comment! The mod is playtested and fairly simple but you never know.
